initiatives.name: Board Composition Refresh
initiatives.summary: Hudson La Force and Barbara Thoralfsson were appointed as new non-executive Directors during the year following a formal search process, bringing operational transformation, capital allocation, remuneration, sustainability and governance expertise to the Board.

evidence.title: Two new non-executive Directors appointed

evidence.quote: Two new non-executive Directors, Hudson La Force and Barbara Thoralfsson, were appointed during the year. Both appointments followed the formal and rigorous process outlined below.

evidence.title: CFO transition and Board succession changes
evidence.summary: Carole Cran transitioned from non-executive Director to executive Director, becoming Group CFO effective 1 April 2025. Additionally, Jo Harlow is stepping down at the 2026 AGM, with Sharmila Nebhrajani OBE becoming Senior Independent Director and Giles Kerr succeeding as Chair of the Remuneration Committee.
evidence.quote: In the prior year, Carole Cran transitioned from her role as a non-executive Director to an executive Director, assuming the position of Group CFO with effect from 1 April 2025. Jo Harlow will be stepping down from the Board at the 2026 AGM, having served more than nine years as a non-executive Director.

initiatives.name: Brownline Acquisition
initiatives.summary: Halma acquired Brownline during the year for a total estimated consideration of €130.4m (£113.4m), adding intangible assets, goodwill and operations to the Group. The acquisition was individually material due to its impact on revenue, intangible assets and goodwill.

evidence.title: Acquisition of Brownline for €130.4m
evidence.summary: Halma acquired Brownline during the year for a total estimated consideration of €130.4m (£113.4m), adding intangible assets, goodwill and operations to the Group. The acquisition was individually material due to its impact on revenue, intangible assets and goodwill.
evidence.quote: Brownline was acquired for a total estimated consideration of €130.4m (£113.4m). The initial consideration comprised the cash- and debt-free purchase price of €145.7m (£126.7m), plus cash acquired of €6.4m (£5.6m) less debt acquired of €21.7m (£18.9m).

initiatives.name: Board Diversity Policy
initiatives.summary: Halma has set a Board Diversity Policy target of at least 20% of UK senior management positions to be held by individuals from ethnically diverse backgrounds by December 2027, in response to the Parker Review recommendations. As of 31 March 2026, the figure was 23%.

evidence.title: Board Diversity Policy targets ethnic diversity
evidence.summary: Halma has set a Board Diversity Policy target of at least 20% of UK senior management positions to be held by individuals from ethnically diverse backgrounds by December 2027, in response to the Parker Review recommendations. As of 31 March 2026, the figure was 23%.
evidence.quote: Our Board Diversity Policy targets at least 20% of our UK senior management positions (defined as members of the Executive Board and their direct reports, excluding administration staff) to be held by individuals from ethnically diverse backgrounds by December 2027. As at 31 March 2026, in line with the Parker Review's updated definition, the percentage was 23%.

initiatives.name: DCR Inspection Systems Bolt-On Acquisition
initiatives.summary: Subsequent to year end, Halma acquired the entire share capital of DCR Inspection Systems Ltd, a UK drainage equipment rental provider and existing Minicam partner, for £8m cash consideration as a bolt-on to its Minicam business within the Environmental & Analysis Sector.

evidence.title: Bolt-on acquisition of DCR Inspection Systems
evidence.summary: Subsequent to year end, Halma acquired the entire share capital of DCR Inspection Systems Ltd, a UK drainage equipment rental provider and existing Minicam partner, for £8m cash consideration as a bolt-on to its Minicam business within the Environmental & Analysis Sector.
evidence.quote: On 1 April 2026, the Company acquired the entire share capital of DCR Inspection Systems Ltd ('DCR'), based in Pontyclun, Wales, UK for a cash consideration of £8m on a cash- and debt-free basis as a bolt-on for its Minicam business.

initiatives.name: External Audit Tender Process
initiatives.summary: Halma commenced an external audit tender process during FY2026, in line with policy to consider tendering every five years, with a new auditor to be appointed effective 1 April 2027 subject to shareholder approval.

evidence.title: External audit tender process underway
evidence.summary: Halma commenced an external audit tender process during FY2026, in line with policy to consider tendering every five years, with a new auditor to be appointed effective 1 April 2027 subject to shareholder approval.
evidence.quote: In line with the information provided in our Annual Report and Accounts 2025, an external audit tender process commenced during the financial year ended 31 March 2026, and will conclude during 2026, with the preferred firm appointed with effect from 1 April 2027, subject to shareholder approval at the 2027 AGM.

initiatives.name: Internal Controls Framework Enhancement
initiatives.summary: Halma has continued preparatory work to formalise and streamline its internal controls framework in order to meet the first disclosure requirements under Provision 29 of the UK Corporate Governance Code 2024, with reporting due in the Annual Report 2027.

evidence.title: Preparatory work for UK Corporate Governance Code Provision 29
